name: Ajejey Smart Table of Contents
author: ajejey

sections.description:
Ajejey Smart Table of Contents creates a professional table of contents from your content headings (H1-H6) with smooth scroll navigation and multiple design templates.

Key Features

  • Automatic Generation – Scans your content and generates TOC automatically
  • Smooth Scroll – Beautiful smooth scrolling to sections
  • 7 Design Templates – Choose from Minimal, Boxed, Bordered, Gradient, Card, Sidebar, or Compact styles
  • Show/Hide Toggle – Collapsible TOC with smooth animation
  • Flexible Positioning – Before content, after content, or use shortcode
  • Heading Selection – Choose which heading levels to include (H1-H6)
  • Customizable – Colors, fonts, and styling options
  • Mobile Responsive – Works perfectly on all devices
  • SEO Friendly – Helps with content structure and user experience
  • Accessible – WCAG 2.1 AA compliant
  • Lightweight – Less than 20KB total size
  • No jQuery – Pure JavaScript for better performance

How to Use

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. TOC will automatically appear on posts/pages with 3+ headings
  3. Customize settings in Settings > TOC Generator
  4. Use shortcode [toc] for manual placement

Perfect For

  • Bloggers with long-form content
  • Content marketers
  • News and magazine websites
  • Documentation sites
  • Educational websites
  • Any site with structured content
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/ajejey-smart-toc/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Go to Settings > TOC Generator to configure
  4. That’s it! TOC will appear automatically on eligible posts/pages
sections.faq:
Does it work with page builders?

Yes! Ajejey Smart Table of Contents works with Gutenberg, Classic Editor, Elementor, and other popular page builders.

Can I customize the design?

Absolutely! Choose from 7 templates and customize colors, fonts, and more in the settings.

Will it slow down my site?

No! The plugin is extremely lightweight (< 20KB) and optimized for performance.

Can I use it multiple times on one page?

Currently, one TOC per page is supported. Multiple TOCs will be added in a future update.

Does it work on mobile?

Yes! The plugin is fully responsive and works beautifully on all devices.
